name: Crabrawler
notes: Painted design: flat purple and blue shell panels with soft painted shading and thin dark outlines where panels overlap: body (7), face plate (10, with cream mouth plates split by dark lines), belly (12, blue stripes), legs (1, 9: purple with a cream joint band and a blue tip), big blue boxing claws (2, 6, 11) with a dark opening (3), cream pincer crest (8) and cream arm joints (5, 15), a dark patch (13), small purple parts (4, 14).

So: crab carapace = hard, smooth, satin. Shell panels get a groove and soft bevel only on the painted outlines (no new seams), a gentle dome, the painted mottling as faint grain, satin _par; cream pincer and joints smooth with a bit more gloss; dark claw opening and dark patch untouched. No bumps or granules: the artist painted none.
BodyA shader 3436703351 has no normal sampler: in game only _dif and _par load; Body_nor is cache-only.
